cause_descriptions.PER_ORDER: Average per order cited as a £ figure. The extractor schema has no per-order metric, so the claim is revenue/TW; check_row maps it to Revenue_TW and, because the unit (currency) fits, never tries the row's derived values (per_order is only tried when the unit does not fit). Level 1 supports the same number as per_order(entity.Revenue_TW).
cause_descriptions.UAE_ALIAS: 'UAE' (and 'Emirati') is not in ENTITY_ALIASES, the words test fails ({'uae'} is not a subset of the name's words) and fuzzy WRatio('uae','united arab emirates') is below 85, so the entity is not found.
cause_descriptions.K_TOLERANCE: Value cited in k with the last digit rounded the wrong way (118.12k written 118.2k; 16.455k written 16.4k). matches() also accepts any k/M value within 0.5 percent relative error, so the wrong last digit passes.
cause_descriptions.FUZZY_NAME: Name found only by fuzzy matching (note 'Set of 4' vs table 'SET OF4'; note 'T-Light Holder' vs table 'T-LIGHT HLDR'). The check did find the error, but a fuzzily bound name may not produce a confident Wrong_*, so it becomes Unverifiable.
cause_descriptions.GROUP_BOUND: Group figure with a bound ('more than 49%' for the top-five share of 49.88%). group_value_match calls first_match without allow_bounds, so the bound is read as an exact 49% and fails; Level 1 allows bounds on lines that name no entity.
cause_descriptions.FAMILY_PLURAL: Family written in the plural ('Feltcraft cushions'). families() matches exact word runs, so FELTCRAFT CUSHION (exactly the three rows) is not found; only FELTCRAFT (9 rows) and BUTTERFLY (2 rows) are, and the short member names in brackets (Owl, Rabbit, Butterfly) are not entity mentions. With 'cushion' the family is found.
cause_descriptions.GROUP_SUBSET: Hand-picked subset of a family named by short names in brackets (5 of the 7 hot water bottle rows). The library has the 7-row HOT WATER BOTTLE family and top-k/rest totals, but not this subset; the short names are not found as entity mentions.
